title: Checkpoint: longest run
prompt: Implement to spec: `longestRun(String s)` returns the length of the longest run of equal consecutive characters. "abbbcc" -> 3 (the run of b's); "abc" -> 1; single characters count as runs of length 1. Precondition: s has at least one character.

tests.name: run boundaries
tests.hint: track current run and best run; reset current when the char changes.
